summary:
Iteration 15 verified end-to-end: guest View-only cards, guest product-detail login-to-order-card with redirect-back, logged-in ordering visibility, and new_registration WhatsApp admin notification. Backend 5/5 pytest PASS; Frontend 6/6 Playwright PASS on live preview.

(1) GUEST PRODUCT CARDS = VIEW ONLY: /products as guest — product-card-nerviphos-m renders view-product-nerviphos-m (visible) and add-to-cart-nerviphos-m is ABSENT (locator count=0). PASS.

(2) GUEST PRODUCT DETAIL: /products/nerviphos-m as guest — login-to-order-card visible with title 'Login to View Your Prices', detail-register-btn and detail-login-btn both visible; qty-input, detail-add-to-cart, buy-now all ABSENT (count=0 each). PASS.

(3) LOGIN REDIRECT URL: clicking detail-login-btn navigates to /account?redirect=%2Fproducts%2Fnerviphos-m (URL-encoded slug present). PASS.

(4) REDIRECT BACK AFTER LOGIN: OTP login via POST /api/auth/otp/{request,verify} (mobile 9944472488, dev_otp) succeeded; token+customer set in localStorage; navigating to /account?redirect=/products/nerviphos-m redirected via Account.jsx useEffect to /products/nerviphos-m. PASS.

(5) LOGGED-IN PRODUCT DETAIL: qty-input, detail-add-to-cart, buy-now all visible; login-to-order-card count=0. PASS.

(6) LOGGED-IN CARDS: /products cards show BOTH view-product-{slug} AND add-to-cart-{slug}; clicking Add triggered 'Added to cart' toast and cart badge updated to 1. PASS.

BACKEND (pytest test_iter15_guest_view.py): (a) /api/products returns items list, (b) guest /api/products/nerviphos-m returns 200 with no your_price, (c) OTP request+verify+authorized /api/products/{slug} returns 200, (d) POST /api/auth/register with fresh unique 10-digit mobile returns {registered:true,status:'pending'} AND GET /api/admin/notifications?channel=whatsapp contains an entry with kind='new_registration' and text containing 'New VETMECH registration' + mobile, (e) duplicate registration returns 409. 5/5 PASS in 5.5s.

Note: The review request referenced example slug 'vetmech-pharma' as a template — actual seeded product slugs are nerviphos-m, vetkclor, mastobliss-tsc. Tests used nerviphos-m; data-testid patterns (view-product-{slug}, add-to-cart-{slug}) work identically per ProductCard.jsx implementation.
critical_code_review_comments: ProductCard.jsx correctly gates Add button behind useAuth().customer — guest branch renders single full-width View button, logged-in branch renders View+Add. Clean conditional.

ProductDetail.jsx correctly wraps qty/add/buy block in `customer ?` conditional; guest branch renders login-to-order-card with detail-register-btn navigating to /register?redirect=... and detail-login-btn to /account?redirect=... — both URL-encoded via encodeURIComponent.
Account.jsx useEffect ((customer, redirect)) triggers navigate(redirect, {replace:true}) once customer state is set post-login. Verified functional via localStorage seed.
auth_routes.register() iterates wa.admin_numbers and calls send_whatsapp(..., kind='new_registration'). Notification is persisted and retrievable via /api/admin/notifications.
test_credentials: Admin: vetmechpharma@gmail.com / Admin@123; Customer OTP mobile 9944472488 (dev_otp in API response). Registration test uses fresh random 10-digit mobiles each run.
seed_data_creation: Each test_new_registration_creates_whatsapp_notification run creates one TEST_REG_{mobile} customer (source=self_registration, status=pending). Non-destructive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Guest gating verified. Seeded product slugs are nerviphos-m, vetkclor, mastobliss-tsc (not 'vetmech-pharma' as literal). Use nerviphos-m for guest-vs-logged-in tests. Test registration creates pending customers; cleanup not automated but harmless.
